name: Study Residence Permit

requirements.blocker_text: Requires enrollment in higher or vocational education at an authorised Georgian institution.
Requires monthly funds equal to at least 2 times Georgia's official minimum subsistence level.
requirements.fix_path: Document qualifying monthly funds before applying.

evidence_required.document: Proof of enrollment at an authorised institution
Proof of funds (2x minimum subsistence level)

outcome.duration_length: 6 months to 1 year initially, extendable up to a cumulative 12 years

sources.title: Public Service Development Agency of Georgia (sda.gov.ge) -- Migration/Residence Permits

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Georgia's initial build. This is Article 15(b) of the Law on the Legal Status of Aliens and Stateless Persons. Fee: GEL 300-600 (10-30 days). work_rights set 'none': the source does not describe any student work-rights allowance, unlike several other countries in this dataset; not asserted as permitted absent confirmation. leads_to_pr set false since this source does not describe study time as counting toward the 10-year temporary-residence-to-permanent-residence track -- an honest gap, not independently confirmed either way, so treated conservatively rather than assumed to count.
